verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only out-of-the-box views (cost per run, tool failure rates, drift, regressions) and a reference to 'the dashboard'. Nothing documents building custom dashboards, and latency and eval-score panels are never mentioned. Prebuilt analytics are an adjacent feature, not the user-configurable dashboard capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
